offerings.title: Succulent Bar
offerings.body: Floral & Hardy of Skippack is a family-owned garden center and gift shop located in the heart of Skippack Village. You’ll find unique gifts, home & yard décor plus beautiful annuals, perennials, shrubs, and other plants! Browse around the shop and enjoy its whimsical atmosphere and rustic charm.

offerings.title: Gift Shop
offerings.body: Visit Floral & Hardy’s upstairs DIY “ Succulent Bar ” and make your own container with cool toppings. Floral & Hardy also hosts 120+ fun events per year including, free gardening wine & cheese classes, kid & adult workshops, community festivals, and private parties. There’s something for people of all ages at Floral & Hardy of Skippack!
